notes.title: Version 5.0 released
notes.notes:
This major update introduces a complete overhaul of the game's look and feel, with a focus on a modernized user interface.

New illustrations and added visual details reduce the monochrome aesthetic by incorporating some color while maintaining the harsh, uninviting atmosphere of Greymarsh. Screen transitions are less obtrusive. Some tweaks to the lighting system mean improved ambiance. A pair of almost-typos have been removed.

The goal has been (as with all the previous updates) to create a smoother and more immersive gaming experience.

notes.title: Version 4.1 released
notes.notes:
In this update:

Additions to the story
Visual improvements to the user interface
Fixes for some bugs and typos

notes.title: Version 4.0 released
notes.notes:
Greymarsh is heavily inspired by classical, old-school gamebooks from the eighties and nineties, with their simple battle systems based on dice rolls. With this update, Greymarsh goes all the way and makes the mechanics of combat explicit with dice rolls on screen, showing more clearly where randomly generated numbers play a part in the flow of battle.

Some other graphical flourishes are introduced as well, like red bars showing the remaining hit points for player and opponent alike.

As usual, a few minor bugs and typos have been removed.

notes.title: Update notes for version 3.01

notes.title: Version 3.0 released
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43844832/e48f07aea51580a0474e7a297ef3de8e30c58133.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43844832/59716807da89e7141e0ad554fb1c8ca0869f74d8.png[/img][/url]Greymarsh was published almost one year ago. Since launch, steady additions and design changes have resulted in a very different game compared to the first version.

The main aim of this update is to increase the immersion even more by making the UI more dynamic and adding subtle lighting effects that match the story.

Some new locations and characters have been added, and some bugs and typos have been removed.

notes.title: Release of version 2.1: Urban chronicles
notes.notes:
The key features of this update include:

* Increased number of characters for potential interaction and various opportunities
* Addition of street events in Greymarsh
* Added illustrations
* Language overhaul
* Several bug fixes
